name: @hadoku/server
description: The site: cardtable's loopback tunnel server. Boots the kernel with Magic's plugins (@hadoku/magic-server) and bomberman's room type, serves the built @hadoku/ui SPA, and is the bundle PM2 runs (dist/index.js).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts ../../games/magic/server/src/pools/catalog-build-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --external:express --external:socket.io --external:@wolffm/rooms-protocol --external:@wolffm/rooms-server --external:@resvg/resvg-js && node ../../scripts/release/print-build-version.ts > dist/version.txt && tsx ../../games/magic/server/src/cli/warm-bridges.ts
